snippet.title: Go Vacation (Switch) - Kawawii Island Complete (4 Players: Maurits, Rik, Myrte & Thessy)
snippet.description:
We play Go Vacation for Nintendo Switch with 4 players playing through the whole game. Go Vacation is like Wii Sports Resort or Switch Sports except it has way more sports. Go vacation was originally released on the Wii in 2011 and got ported to the switch in 2018. We play the Nintendo Switch version! :)

In Go Vacation you can play all kinds of sports on Kawawii Island. Kawawii Island is separated in 4 resorts: 
The Marine Resort where you can swim, surf and other water sports.
The City Resort which is just a giant skate park with lots of tracks everywhere.
The Snow Resort is a mountain where you can go slide down with ski's, snowboards or a snow tube.
The Mountain Resort is a green mountainous area with a nice lake where you can ride horses or canoe across the rivers.
